Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — UrbanForge is excited about the pilot. Finance asked whether Redwood can provide a quarterly billing option on Net-90 terms for our pilot (single enterprise org, estimated usage ~ $35k/mo). They also asked whether a one-time onboarding discount (15% off first two quarters) would be possible given the procurement timing across our global finance org.

We can send a PO from procurement next week (they requested the formal payment terms in writing). Would Redwood consider:
- Quarterly invoicing, Net-90 for invoices (pilot period only)
- A 15% onboarding discount applied to invoices for first two quarters

If there are guardrails you need (escrow, usage caps, milestone invoices), please let me know and I can share with our finance team.

Appreciate any guidance — Elena

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Net-90 quarterly invoicing option + PO incoming

Thanks Karthik. High-level finance thoughts: we can consider a conditional Net-90 quarterly cadence for a pilot, but we need to mitigate cash and credit risk. Proposed guardrails:
- Limit exception to the first two quarters of the engagement only (review before Q3 billing)
- Require a PO covering the first quarter on signature; we can invoice quarterly thereafter on Net-90 provided the PO/PO-equivalent is in place
- Holdback / escrow or a 15% advance on the first invoice OR a usage cap at 130% of committed baseline to avoid runaway consumption risk
- Discount: 15% onboarding discount is acceptable for the first two quarters if applied as a one-time credit (not ongoing list discount)

If Legal signs off on contract language and RevOps (Priyom) configures billing appropriately, I can approve this conditionally. Need clarity on PO timing and whether UrbanForge can sign DocuSign with the revised payment clause.

Attachment: none

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@urbanforge.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Net-90 quarterly invoicing option + PO incoming

Karthik / Marissa — legal notes for an exception:
- We can reflect Net-90 quarterly invoicing in the SOW/addendum for the pilot term only, with an automatic reversion to standard terms (Net-30 monthly) after two quarters unless an exec-level renewal is approved
- Require the PO to reference the deal id and include the billing contact for AP
- Add a clause that late payments may trigger a pause on service or require prepayment for future months (we typically avoid punitive language, but need operational remedies)
- No change to liability caps or indemnities for this exception

I can draft a short addendum that captures these points. Legal would prefer a security/credit card on file if UrbanForge cannot provide escrow or prepayment. Please confirm whether UrbanForge can provide the PO and whether they can accept the addendum.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: Net-90 quarterly invoicing option + PO incoming

Quick note from RevOps side: if we proceed with conditional Net-90 for two quarters we need to record this as a billing exception in RevOps and set an automatic renewal review flag at the start of Q3. Action items for UrbanForge / AE: please get PO to reference deal DF-4498 and include expected monthly usage baseline. Finance/legal requirements summarized below so we have one place to track:
- PO referencing deal DF-4498 (required)
- 15% onboarding credit applied as a one-time invoice credit (Finance)
- Either: escrow / 15% advance on first invoice OR credit card on file + usage cap at 130% baseline
- Legal addendum (Laura) to cover Net-90 pilot term and remedies for non-payment

If you can get the PO and confirm the preferred guardrail option, I will configure the exception and mark the deal for a Q3 renewal review.

Priyom Das
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@urbanforge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: FINAL: Conditional approval for UrbanForge Net-90 quarterly billing (DF-4498)

Team — final sign-off from Finance: conditional approval granted with the following mandatory conditions (no exceptions):
1) UrbanForge must provide PO referencing DF-4498 prior to first invoice
2) Apply a one-time 15% onboarding credit across the first two quarterly invoices (Finance will apply as credit)
3) UrbanForge to either place 15% of the first-quarter invoice into escrow OR provide a corporate card on file with authorization to charge if invoices are >45 days overdue
4) Usage cap at 130% of the committed baseline; overages billed at list rates and require pre-approval
5) Addendum drafted by Legal (Laura) reflecting Net-90 for pilot term only with automatic reversion to Net-30 thereafter

Once the PO and guardrail selection (escrow vs card on file) are confirmed, Priyom will enact the billing exception and set the Q3 review. Karthik, please relay these conditions to Elena and update the HubSpot deal record.

Attachment: pricing_summary.xlsx (pricing and credit calculation worksheet)

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
